full_details: The lodging held the whole day. You took the cloth off Holinshed and read, and you did not start a speech for anyone in it. Brooke stayed where Sunday had left him. At the table the loaf was still a finger short of the notch. You told them the horse is Wednesday, at first light, and that tomorrow is the quarter and not the road. You wrote a few lines that refuse a beginning, and you covered the book again before the candle. The sixty shillings were still in the canvas. The bay was still not taken. No one came up the stair with a message. The long page stayed face down.
one_sentence: You kept the chronicle open through the afternoon and put the cloth back before you slept.
title: Read the chronicle and covered it again
